channel.title: Wire — DevOps
channel.description: DevOps from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Terraform AWS Provider Continues Rapid Expansion as AWS Infrastructure Becomes More Complex
item.description: The Terraform AWS Provider continues its rapid evolution, with v6.62.0 adding support for new AWS capabilities while improving how Terraform understands and manages existing infrastructure. By Craig Risi (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Scheduler Preemption for In-Place Pod Resize (Alpha)
item.description: In Kubernetes, resource allocation has historically been a static decision made during a Pod's initial scheduling and placement. (1 source: kubernetesblog)

item.title: Session Traces and Cost Controls Help Diagnose AI Agent Failures
item.description: Session traces and cost controls are emerging as key observability techniques for diagnosing AI agent failures, helping teams spot tool-call loops and runaway spend while preserving enough execution context for post-incident debugging. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Introducing Node Lifecycle Conditions
item.description: Kubernetes has many ways to describe what is happening on a Node. Readiness, taints, Pod state, labels, annotations, and provider-specific APIs each expose part of the picture. (1 source: kubernetesblog)
